not_implemented.structural.compression: fixed-N engine: no operation removes configurations while keeping the run comparable
not_implemented.memory.history_fork: Engine.fork is an exact continuation (bit-identical, tested), so it is not a perturbation

performance_by_regime.note: cell-seed level; contrasts paired within cell and seed; Holm over all contrasts

tracker_informative_while_comparator_inv.note: tracking_preserved uses the full-stream tracker (information advantage); the sensor-only tracker's detection is reported in tracking_by_regime

structure_learning_overlap.definition: fixed-model validity < 0.5 while the adaptive (structure-learning-lite) model keeps ≥ 0.8

temporal.interface_drift.rule: staleness = longest change period at which the adaptive comparator's success is no longer better than no control (mean ≤ 0 or paired p > 0.05)

temporal.world_drift.rule: staleness = longest change period at which the adaptive comparator's success is no longer better than no control (mean ≤ 0 or paired p > 0.05)

history_reentry.note: reactivate vs remove are paired within seed and severity (identical until t_r). Pattern recurrence = corr(T's per-configuration profile before onset, after t_r). Migration gain = corr(source profile before, destination profile after) − the same before migration.
